pr.title: feat(cli): restore stack from remote
pr.body: Closes #151 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add credits command (#159)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/159)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): list shows review numbers (#158)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/158)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): restore stack from remote (#157)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/157)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(docs): add 'undo' guide tour (#156)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/156)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(providers): parse host better pt. 2 (#155)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/155)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(docs): mention more flags in readme (#154)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/154)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(docs): cursor in guide always restored (#153)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/153)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): retry on transient merge fail (#152)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/152)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): treat trunk as empty stack line (#150)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/150)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): share lock across worktrees (#148)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/148)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): defer rename supersession to stack submit (#147)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/147)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): guard walk against metadata cycles (#146)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/146)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: apply_remote_metadata passes branch and parent names read from untrusted remote metadata straight to git fetch/config, so a name like `--upload-pack=...` is parsed as a git option (argument injection).
